methodologyNote: Measured via page views with full browser version detail.

aiSummary: In October 2026, Chrome for Android led browser versions (mobile) in Asia at 75.28% (market share of tracked page views / usage). Safari iPhone ranked second at 12.55%, followed by Chrome for iPhone at 4.33%.

faqs.question: Which item leads browser versions (mobile) in Asia?
faqs.answer: Chrome for Android leads at 75.28% in October 2026 (market share of tracked page views / usage). Source: https://gs.statcounter.com/browser-version-market-share/mobile/asia.

faqs.question: What does the market share of tracked page views / usage metric mean?
faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.

faqs.question: What are the top three for browser versions (mobile) in Asia?
faqs.answer: Chrome for Android (75.28%), Safari iPhone (12.55%), Chrome for iPhone (4.33%) in October 2026.
